priority_items.title: Transboundary haze: SGP all-moderate at 16:00 SGT cutoff; MYS still ~40 unhealthy; IDN health print unchanged
priority_items.summary: NEA 16:00 SGT 16 Sep 24h PSI all moderate (N74/C91/W79/E76/S71) vs island-wide unhealthy 15 Sep. 1h PM2.5 all normal (C54 still <55). haze.gov.sg 11:44 AM: Unhealthy over Peninsular MYS and southern VNM; some Kalimantan–Sumatra Unhealthy-to-Hazardous. Star 10:00 MYT APIMS: 40 nationwide unhealthy, Johan Setia 187; Awani 12:40 MYT Johan Setia 185 / still 40. School-close API 200 not met. IDN Health Ministry last official: 12.5m exposed / ARI 113,336 by 9 Sep.

priority_items.title: Thailand–Cambodia UNCLOS Annex V conciliation opens at PCA Singapore
priority_items.summary: First meeting 14–16 Sep. Fiery 15 Sep openings over collapse of the 2001 MOU. Process ~12 months; recommendations non-binding. No published Rules of Procedure or close note at 16:00 SGT cutoff. Not a binding delimitation and not a Koh Kood sovereignty award.

priority_items.title: BARMM first elected parliament is hung: BFP 31 / UBJP 30, no 41-seat majority
priority_items.summary: RBOC party-seat allocation BFP 16 / UBJP 15 / BGC 8 / RDP 1. Rappler combined 80-seat tally BFP 31 / UBJP 30 / BGC 8 / SIAP 6 / others 5. Special term 30 Oct 2026–30 Jun 2031. Comelec.gov.ph combined proclamation text not retrieved. Comelec: 4 dead / 19 injured in Cotabato City.

priority_items.title: AMCDR day 2 in Manila: Manila Declaration text unpublished at cutoff
priority_items.summary: PH Chair flagship 15–16 Sep. Marcos five priorities + proposed Manila-ASPECT. AHA Centre warehouses already in PHL/THA/MYS/IDN. Philstar/Time.news still future-tense on the Manila Declaration. No OCD/PNA/ASEAN.org close text. No emergency AMM. No confirmed haze paragraph.

priority_items.title: Indonesia Java Sea ferry SAR: 129 still missing; search area expanded
priority_items.summary: KM Virgo Transport 8, 243 aboard. Last Basarnas tally 22:00 WITA 15 Sep: 108 survivors, 6 dead, 129 missing. Day-4 expansion to 6,120 NM² / six sectors. National SAR, not FLASH.

priority_items.title: AFP: no confirmed Chinese drilling at Bajo de Masinloc after 28-day presence
priority_items.summary: RADM Trinidad 15 Sep 19:17 PHT: tracks consistent with surveillance/research, not stationary drilling. No shots-fired/collision in window. Secondary reprint: 48 CCG/PLAN vessels 8–14 Sep across four WPS features.
